method: Plant an X1 Carbon + firmware fact in session A, then recall it in (a) session A, (b) a fresh session B, and (c) a mismatched pair sessionId=A, uuid=B.

tests.name: A plant
tests.output: I have noted that you own a Bambu Lab X1 Carbon running firmware version 01.08.02.00. Based on your current firmware version, your printer supports the Offline Update function...

tests.name: A recall (sessionId=A, uuid=A)
tests.output: You told me you are running a Bambu Lab X1 Carbon with firmware version 01.08.02.00.

tests.name: B recall (sessionId=B, uuid=B)
tests.output: I do not have a record of the printer model or firmware version you are running from the start of this conversation.

tests.name: Mismatch (sessionId=A, uuid=B)
tests.output: I do not have a record of the printer model or firmware version you are running from the start of this conversation.

verdict: Isolation holds. History follows the uuid (or the sessionId+uuid pair), not sessionId alone. No cross-session read via this vector.
